about.title: About MIMIC
about.text:
MIMIC is a LAN social deduction chat game for 3–15 players. Everyone receives a random animal identity. One player is secretly the Mimic and gets a target player to imitate in style, tone, and habits — while ordinary players try to spot the impostor.

Rules:
• Discuss in chat during each round, then vote when the timer ends.
• Eliminated players become spectators (they cannot chat or vote), and their true role stays hidden until the very end.
• Voting Skip skips elimination; if all active players vote Skip, the match ends immediately.
• Ordinary players win only if the Mimic is eliminated without exceeding the allowed mistake limit (1 wrong elimination per 3 starting players). Otherwise, the Mimic wins.
